book.name: 2 Aj Tesalónica
book.title: Tkabꞌ Tuꞌj Pabl kye Nimil aj Tesalónica

content: Qo naꞌn Dios, tuꞌn tkanin Tyol Dios toj tkyaqil twutz txꞌotxꞌ
Atzin jaꞌlin, erman, chi naꞌn Diosa qiꞌja, tuꞌn tkanin Tbꞌanil Tqanil qAjaw liwey toj tkyaqil twutz txꞌotxꞌ, ex tuꞌn tkubꞌ nimin, tzeꞌnkuxjo tej xpon kanin kyxola.
Ex chi naꞌn Diosa qiꞌja tuꞌn qkleta toj kyqꞌobꞌxjal piꞌsqe ex aj ilqe, quꞌn nya tkyaqilxjal nimilqe tiꞌj Tyol Dios.
Me me te Dios tzꞌaqlexix teꞌ, ex chi kꞌwel tzyuꞌn tuꞌn jikyinxix, ajxi tjapin bꞌaj tkyaqil; ex ok chi elil kloꞌn tuꞌn, toj tqꞌobꞌ tajaw il.
Ex qꞌuqle qe qkꞌuꞌj tiꞌj qAjaw, quꞌn atziꞌn xi qqꞌmaꞌn kyeꞌy, ax nkubꞌ kybꞌinchinjiꞌy, ex noqit kukx kubꞌ kybꞌinchinjiꞌy.
Axit qAjaw tzꞌonin kyeꞌy, tuꞌn tel kynikyꞌa te tqꞌaqꞌbꞌil tkꞌuꞌj qMan Dios kyukꞌiy, ex tuꞌn kykujsin te kyibꞌa, tzeꞌnku te Crist, toj tkyaqiljo a n-ikyꞌx kyuꞌn.
Il tiꞌj tuꞌn qaqꞌnin
Atzin jaꞌlin erman, kxel qqꞌmaꞌn kyeꞌy toj tbꞌi qAjaw Jesucrist, tuꞌn tel kypaꞌn kyibꞌa tiꞌj tkyaqiljo erman, a tkyꞌeꞌ tuꞌn taqꞌnin, ex mi nbꞌet tzeꞌnku tojjo xnaqꞌtzbꞌil, a xi qyekꞌiꞌn.
Qalaꞌ bꞌiꞌn kyuꞌn qa il tiꞌj tuꞌn kyok lipeꞌy tiꞌjjo yekꞌbꞌil xkubꞌ qqꞌoꞌn kywutza, quꞌn nyataq kyꞌajqoꞌy kyxola,
ex mix jaꞌ xqo ok waniꞌy kyiꞌja. Qalaꞌ ma qo aqꞌniꞌn qꞌijl ex qnikyꞌin, tuꞌntzin mi tzꞌoke jun iqtz kyiꞌja.
¿Quꞌn noqittzin ntiꞌtaq qokliꞌn tiꞌj jun onbꞌil, tuꞌn t-xi qqaniꞌn kyeꞌy? Me mi xi qqaniꞌn. Qalaꞌ ma qo aqꞌniꞌn, tuꞌntzintla tkyij qqꞌoꞌn jun yekꞌbꞌil kyeꞌy, tuꞌn kyok lipeꞌy tiꞌj.
Quꞌn tej qteꞌn kyukꞌiy, xi qnikꞌuꞌn kyeꞌy, qa at jun aꞌla tkyꞌeꞌ tzꞌaqꞌnin, ex ntiꞌ tuꞌn twaꞌn.
Nxi qnaꞌnjiꞌy luꞌn kyeꞌy, quꞌn bꞌiꞌn quꞌn qa at junjun kyxola, a kykyꞌeꞌ chi aqꞌnin, ex noq n-ex kyqꞌij kybꞌetbꞌin kytziyile ja.
Me aye xjal lo kxel qqꞌmaꞌn kye toj tbꞌi qAjaw Jesucrist, tuꞌn kyaqꞌnin, tuꞌntzintla tkanbꞌitjo telix kyqꞌij kyuꞌn.
Ayiꞌy erman, mi chi sikytiꞌy tuꞌn kybꞌinchintejiꞌy wen.
Ex qa at jun kyxola mi nkubꞌ tbꞌiꞌn a nxi qqꞌmaꞌn kyeꞌy tojjo uꞌj lo, noq kykaꞌyinka, exsin kypamil kyibꞌa tiꞌj, tuꞌntzin ttzaj txꞌixwe.
Me mi tzꞌel kyikyꞌiꞌn, qalaꞌ kyqꞌoꞌnxa jun tnabꞌl, quꞌn erman.
Jun tqꞌolbꞌil Pabl ex jun naꞌj Dios tuꞌn tjapin bꞌajjo uꞌj lo
Noqit ax qAjaw, a Tajaw tkyaqil nukꞌbꞌil, kukx tzaj qꞌonte tnukꞌbꞌil toj tkyaqil. Ex axit qAjaw ten kyukꞌiy toj tkyaqil.
Atzin qꞌolbꞌil luꞌn ayinkuy Pabl nchin kubꞌ tzꞌibꞌiꞌnte tzeꞌnkuxjo nkubꞌ ntzꞌibꞌinjiꞌy tkyaqil wuꞌja. Ex ikytzin k-elile kynikyꞌjiꞌy te, qa ayinkuy nchin kubꞌ tzꞌibꞌinte uꞌj lo.
Noqit a t-xtalbꞌil qAjaw Jesucrist kyibꞌaja kykyaqila. Ikyxitjo.
